dfa.construction: Longest suffix that is a proper prefix of a forbidden left side; reachable live states only; not minimized.

certificate.pumping_statement: prefix + cycle^k is accepted for every integer k >= 0; all visited states are accepting.

pruner_regression.scope: Finite regression only; global language finiteness is certified separately.

infinite_comparison.interpretation: Infinite accepted words, not an infinite group and not an infinite diameter.

costs.timing_scope: analysis includes all-start rule validation, DFA build/classification, bounded pruner regression, and accepted-word/group comparison; excludes shared preprocessing, disk and independent verification.
